title: Authorized User Limits — Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Tiers
content:
Limits on authorized users of a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account, by tier:

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most authorized users the primary cardholder may add | 1 | 2 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Minimum age of an authorized user (years) | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 |
| Authorized-user additions or removals processed per statement period | 2 | 2 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

- The first line is the ceiling on the number of authorized users on the account at any time.
- The age figure is the minimum age of an authorized user, 16 on every tier.
- The third line is the most authorized-user additions or removals processed in one statement period.
- The Project Loan tiers show 0: a Ridgeline Project Loan carries no authorized users.

Hypothetical: a Card Preferred account with two authorized users is at its tier's ceiling of 2; a Card Premier account with two authorized users is below its ceiling of 4.
